findings.finding: Item 1 is fixed. decide() now returns ok:false when the body is not JSON, when reading the body times out, or when the body has no answers object. jevRank also treats a missing answers.best as a failure in both the batch pass and the global pass. A best value that is present but malformed still goes straight into readBatch with no shape check.

Item 2 is fixed. When a guard trips on the first call (payload or budget), the markdown now prints 'not called, FELL BACK to rules (<reason>)'. When no reason is set it prints 'unknown' instead of 'undefined'.

Item 3 is fixed. Any failure, including a failed global rerank, now returns the full rules order. One edge case remains: if ranked is empty, batches is empty and jev.global stays null, so the code still sends a global call with an empty pool instead of skipping it. Check that explore() always skips Jev when the pool is empty.

Item 4 is mostly fixed. rg now runs with --hidden, --glob '!.git', '--' and an explicit '.' path. Ties are sorted by path. A leading './' is stripped after backslashes are turned into slashes, so Windows '.\\' prefixes are handled. packages/, bin/ and out/ are no longer in JUNK. Exit 1 (no matches) is correctly treated as no problem. However, exit 2 is reported only when stdout is empty, so a partial failure (some files unreadable) is silently hidden because --no-messages also suppresses stderr. The '!.git' glob only excludes a top-level or nested directory named .git, which is fine, but .git worktree files are still listed.

Because packages/, bin/ and out/ are no longer filtered, real build output in out/ or bin/ (for example .NET bin/Debug) can now rank in the results. Only obj/ is still excluded, and the .dll/.exe/.pdb extension filter only partly limits this.

Item 5 is fixed. Numeric CLI options must now be positive integers or the script exits with code 2. There is no upper bound, so values like --max-calls 100000 or a very large --batch are still accepted.

The decision-provider.mjs hardening is a local copy. There are 13 decision-provider.mjs files under .claude/skills/*/scripts, and the other 12 still have the old behavior: ok:true on a non-JSON or answer-less HTTP 200 body.

All 15 tests pass. The new tests use injected decideImpl and runImpl stubs written for exactly the failure modes being fixed, so they are in-sample regression checks. Nothing runs real rg/git output on Windows, for example '.\\' prefixes or exit 2 with partial output. Add one fixture-based test that runs the real rg.
No secrets and no unsafe writes in this diff. The only write is the existing appendJsonl log, which records the task text and paths, not keys.

Earlier Minor findings were not rechecked against agent-01/agent-review.json because this was a quick pass. The commit does not touch any other area, so treat all earlier Minor findings outside items 1-5 as still open.
